_about: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE COMPANY. Every value below is made up for demonstration (illustrative: true) and must be replaced with your own numbers. Only tokens_per_active_user_per_month starts from data (WildChat).

employees.note: people in scope of the AI programme

adoption_start.note: pilot group already using AI in month 1

adoption_target.note: share of employees using AI at the end of the ramp

ramp_months.note: months to reach the adoption target

tokens_per_active_user_per_month.note: from WildChat consumer chats (about 4,060 output tokens per active user per week x 52/12, output tokens only); replace with your own usage data

price_multiplier_vs_frontier.note: only used with an Epoch price forecast (not available yet)

fixed_token_price_per_mtok.note: flat blended price used because there is no Epoch price forecast; replace with your contract price

base_monthly_hosting_cost.note: infrastructure cost today; moves with the PPI hosting forecast

base_hourly_wage_staff.note: fully loaded staff wage today; moves with the ECI wage forecast

base_hourly_wage_engineer.note: fully loaded engineer wage today; moves with the ECI wage forecast

build_months.note: the build hours are spread evenly over these months

maintenance_share_per_month.note: maintenance after the build, per month

maintenance_during_build.note: also pay maintenance during the build months

work_hours_per_user_per_month.note: working hours per person per month

realisation_rate.note: share of saved time that becomes economic value

benefit_lag_months.note: months after adoption before a user's saving reaches full value

ai_assisted_share_of_hours.note: share of an active user's hours spent on AI-assisted tasks; converts METR's task-time change (downside) to a share of work hours
